title: The Doll (FCP 2026)
synopsis: Eastern France, nowadays. Rémi, who has never recovered from a heartbreak, shares his life with a doll called Audrey. But the day his new coworker, Patricia, arrives at his company, Audrey comes to life. The two women will turn Rémi’s life upside down.

synopsis_lang.en: Eastern France, nowadays. Rémi, who has never recovered from a heartbreak, shares his life with a doll called Audrey. But the day his new coworker, Patricia, arrives at his company, Audrey comes to life. The two women will turn Rémi’s life upside down.
synopsis_lang.zh_hk: Rémi 一直未能走出情傷，與一個名叫 Audrey 的洋娃娃共同生活。直至新同事 Patricia 來到公司那天，Audrey 竟活了過來。兩個女人將把 Rémi 的人生搞得天翻地覆。

cast: Vincent Macaigne, Zoé Marchal, Cécile De France, Adèle Journeaux
